y-m-66-06.topic: Hanyoyin nemo abin da aka samu mabambanta: nemo shi a fakaice da layukan tanget
y-m-66-06.goal: Saita furucin gangarar layin tanget a wani maki na da’irar da aka bayar ta ma’auni; gano maki inda furucin ba a ayyana shi ba; sannan ka gyara maganar “ana iya samunta a kowane maki” da sharadi.
y-m-66-06.material: Yi la’akari da da’irar x²+y²=25 (karanta: x squared plus y squared equals 25). Idan aka ɗauki y yana canzawa bisa x kusa da maki kamar (3; 4) da (4; 3), nemo abin da aka samu a ɓangarorin biyu bisa x don samun gangarar layin tanget dy/dx. y-m-66-06.s.s1.prompt: Idan aka nemo abin da aka samu a ɓangarorin x²+y²=25 bisa x, ta yaya ake amfani da saurin canjin y²?
y-m-66-06.s.s1.hint.0: Idan x ya canza daga 3 zuwa 3.01, don maki ya zauna a kan da’irar, y yana canzawa daga kusan 4 zuwa 3.9925. Lissafta nawa y² ya canza.

y-m-66-06.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ya manta cewa saurin canjin aikin haɗe yana ninkawa, ya ƙara shi maimakon haka.
y-m-66-06.s.s1.r.c: Wannan ya nuna cewa y yana canzawa bisa x, saboda haka ana ninka da saurin canjin y.
y-m-66-06.s.s1.explain: Tun da y yana canzawa bisa x, saurin canjin y² yana ninkawa da saurin canjin y, dy/dx. Don haka 2x+2y·(dy/dx)=0, idan y≠0 kuma dy/dx=−x/y.
y-m-66-06.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi maki (x,y) masu cikakkun coordinates a da’irar, ka nemo maki 3 da aka tantance gangarar tangent a cikinsu kuma ƙimominsu mabambanta ne. (Maki masu gangara iri ɗaya suna ƙirguwa guda.)

y-m-66-10.goal: Yayin da bayanai suke ƙaruwa, fahimci cewa ƙimar integral tabbatacce 0 ba tana nufin abu bai motsa ba. Ka ƙirƙiri tambayoyi biyu da kanka, waɗanda suke tambayar sauyin matsayi da nisan tafiya daga aikin gudu ɗaya, sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa amsoshin suka bambanta.
y-m-66-10.material: Wani abu yana motsi a kan layin lambobi. A lokacin t daƙiƙa (0≤t≤π; π≈3.14, ana auna kusurwoyi da radians), gudunsa v(t)=cos t (m/s) ne. Ƙima tabbatacciya tana nufin motsi zuwa alkiblar +, ƙima mara kyau kuma zuwa alkiblar −. Abun yana farawa daga tushe a t=0. Sauyin matsayi shi ne matsayin ƙarshe a cire farkon matsayi (tare da alkibla), nisan tafiya kuma jimillar tsawon da aka yi a zahiri ba tare da la'akari da alkibla ba.
y-m-66-10.thinking.1: Bambanta adadin da tambaya take nema (sauyin matsayi / nisan tafiya)
y-m-66-10.prereq.1: Fahimtar gabatarwa cewa integral tabbatacce ∫v(t)dt shi ne jimillar gudu bisa lokaci (sauyin matsayi)
y-m-66-10.prereq.2: Sauyin alamar aikin cosine da lissafin integral tabbatacce na sin (integral marar iyaka na cos ita ce sin)
y-m-66-10.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, kwatanta ko sabon bayani yana goyon bayan hukuncinka na baya ko yana sa ka sauya shi.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.hint.1: Bambanta ko lambar da ka sani yanzu tana magana kan 'sauyin matsayi' ko 'nisan tafiya'.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.0.info: Integral tabbatacce ∫cos t dt (daga t=0 zuwa π) = sin π − sin 0 = 0. Haka kuma, gudu a t=0 shi ne v(0)=1 m/s.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yanzu menene hukuncinka game da jimillar tsawon da abun ya yi tafiya da gaske daga daƙiƙa 0 zuwa π (nisan tafiya)?
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Ƙimar integral tabbatacce 0 tana nufin sauyin matsayi tare da alkibla (displacement) 0 ne. Ita kaɗai ba ta faɗi komai game da tsawon hanyar da aka yi ba. Yana da ma'ana a yanke cewa ya fi 0 saboda ya fara motsi, ko kuma a ce ana buƙatar ƙarin bayani game da alamar gudu.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 0 m ne. Ƙimar integral 0 ce, saboda haka jimillar tsawon da aka yi tafiya ma 0 ce.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan ya ɗauki ƙimar integral tabbatacce (jimla mai la'akari da alkibla) a matsayin daidai da jimillar tsawon tafiyar da aka yi.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ya fi 0 m. Tuni yana tafiya da gudu 1 m/s a t=0.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan ya yanke hukunci daga shaidar da ta tabbatar cewa yana motsi.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Dole ne a san yadda alamar gudu take sauyawa domin tantance nisan tafiya.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan ya yanke cewa bayanin da ake da shi yanzu bai isa tantance nisan tafiya ba.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Teburin alamar gudu: idan 0<t<π/2, cos t>0 (alkiblar +); a t=π/2, cos t=0 ne; idan π/2<t<π, cos t<0 (alkiblar −).
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Da farko yana tafiya zuwa alkiblar +, daga daƙiƙa π/2 kuma yana dawowa. Ko da matsayin ƙarshe iri ɗaya ne da na farko, ya yi tafiya a tsakani, saboda haka nisan tafiya ya fi 0. Wanda ya jinkirta hukunci a matakin baya yanzu yana da dalili.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Matsayin ƙarshe iri ɗaya ne da na farko, saboda haka nisan tafiya, jimillar hanya, ita ma 0 ce.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan ya fassara komawa wurin farawa a matsayin rashin yin wani tsawon tafiya.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ya yi tafiya zuwa alkiblar + sannan ya dawo ta alkiblar −, saboda haka sauyin matsayi 0 ne amma nisan tafiya ya fi 0.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan ya fahimci dawowa daga sauyin alama, ya bambanta sauyin matsayi da nisan tafiya.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: A ɓangaren tafiya zuwa alkiblar −, ana ƙirga nisan a matsayin mara kyau a haɗa, don haka jimillar ta zama 0.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan ya rasa cewa nisan tafiya ba zai zama mara kyau ba, ya ɗauki jimla mai alamomi a matsayin nisa.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.2.info: Idan aka raba bisa tazara, ∫cos t dt (daga 0 zuwa π/2)=1, ∫cos t dt (daga π/2 zuwa π)=−1.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mene ne nisan tafiya daga daƙiƙa 0 zuwa π?
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.2.after: A tazara ta farko nisan +1 m ne, a ta biyu kuma −1 m ne, don haka sauyin matsayi 0 ne, amma nisan tafiya 1+1=2 m ne. Ƙimar integral tabbatacce 0 ita ce sauyin matsayi; nisan tafiya kuma integral ne na cikakkiyar ƙimar gudu.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 0 m (tara ƙimomin integral na tazarorin 1 da −1 yadda suke)
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wannan ya tara ƙimomin integral na tazarorin tare da alamominsu, ya amsa sauyin matsayi a matsayin nisan tafiya.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 1 m (ƙirga tsawon tazara ɗaya kawai daga biyun da aka ambata)
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan ya bar tsawon tazarar dawowar.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 2 m (tara tsawon 1 da 1 na tazarorin biyu)
y-m-66-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan ya yi watsi da alkibla, ya tara girman tsawon tazarorin.
y-m-66-10.s.s1.reflect: Kwatanta hukuncinka na farko da na ƙarshe. Wane bayani ne ya sa ka sauya hukunci? Idan ka zaɓi b ko c da farko, rubuta yadda dalilanka suka sauya yayin da hukuncin ya tsaya.
y-m-66-10.s.s2.prompt: Da v(t)=cos t iri ɗaya (0≤t≤π), ƙirƙiri jimla ɗaya ga tambayar da amsarta 0 m, da wata ga wadda amsarta 2 m, sannan ka bayyana dalilin bambancin amsoshin.
y-m-66-10.s.s2.hint.0: Ga tambayoyin biyu, rubuta ko kowacce tana tambayar 'bambancin matsayin farko da na ƙarshe' ko 'tsawon da aka yi tafiya a zahiri', domin a bambanta su.
y-m-66-10.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta yadda ake tara ƙimomin integral na tazarorin 1 da −1 da aka samu a s1 don samun 0, da kuma yadda ake tara su don samun 2.
y-m-66-10.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: idan tambayar sauyin matsayi ce, ...; idan tambayar nisan tafiya ce, ...

Idan kuma 'Mene ne ainihin nisan da abun ya yi tafiya daga daƙiƙa 0 zuwa π?', to ∫|cos t|dt=1+1=2 m. Sauyin matsayi yana la'akari da alkibla don haka sassan suna soke juna; nisan tafiya yana tara tsawo kawai, saboda haka sun bambanta.
y-m-66-10.s.s2.model.1: Amsar 'Yaya nisan abun daga wurin farawa bayan daƙiƙa π (sauyin matsayi)?' ita ce 0 m. Amsar 'Menene jimillar hanyar da abun ya yi a zahiri (nisan tafiya)?' ita ce 2 m. Ya yi tafiyar 1 m gaba sannan 1 m ya dawo; saboda haka matsayin iri ɗaya ne amma tsawon hanya 2 m ne.

y-m-66-10.s.s2.model.3: Idan aka tambayi 'Nawa matsayin ya sauya cikin daƙiƙa π?', matsayi na ƙarshe a cire na farko shi ne 1+(−1)=0 m; idan aka tambayi 'Menene jimillar tsawon da aka yi tafiya?', ita ce |1|+|−1|=2 m. Idan abu ya tafi ya dawo, ƙimomin masu alama suna soke juna amma tsawo yana taruwa.

y-m-66-01.topic: Iyakar jeri: bambancin manyan lambobi biyu marasa iyaka
y-m-66-01.goal: Koyi cewa kalmomin 'bambancin ƙimomi biyu da suke ƙaruwa ba tare da iyaka ba' ba su tantance sakamakon da kansu, nemo layin mafita da ya yi kuskure, sannan ka gano iyaka daidai ta lura da ƙimomi da sauya magana.
y-m-66-01.material: Minsu ya yi ƙoƙarin nemo ƙimar nan a aikin gida na iyaka. Ga jeri aₙ = √(n²+n) − n (n cikakkiyar lamba ce mai kyau; karanta: tushen murabba'in n murabba'i da n, a cire n), nemo ƙimar da aₙ ke kusantowa yayin da n ke ƙaruwa ba tare da iyaka ba. Mafitar Minsu ita ce layuka huɗu da ke ƙasa. Ƙimomin kalkuleta ƙiyastattun ƙimomi ne da aka rubuta a decimal na ainihin ƙimomin.

y-m-66-01.prereq.1: Ma'anar iyakar jeri: yayin da n ke ƙaruwa ba tare da iyaka ba, mambobi suna ƙara kusantar wata lamba.
y-m-66-01.prereq.2: Abin da ∞ ba lamba ba ne, alama ce ta yanayin 'ƙaruwa ba tare da iyaka ba'.
y-m-66-01.prereq.3: Lissafin maganganu masu tushen murabba'i (ninka tushen murabba'i, samfurin jimla da bambancin maganganu biyu)

y-m-66-01.s.s1.line.1: Idan aka cire babbar lamba daga babbar lamba, ƙimomin biyu kusan iri ɗaya suke, saboda haka bambancin yana kusantar 0.

(n+1)−n yana kusantar 1, 2n−n yana ƙaruwa ba tare da iyaka ba, n−n kuma 0 ne. y-m-66-01.s.s3.model.0: Ninka √(n²+n)−n da √(n²+n)+n a sama da ƙasa; mai ƙidaya ya zama (n²+n)−n²=n, don haka aₙ=n/(√(n²+n)+n). Idan aka raba mai ƙidaya da mai rarrabawa da n, ana samun 1/(√(1+1/n)+1); yayin da n ke ƙaruwa, 1/n yana kusantar 0, saboda haka iyaka ita ce 1/2.

y-m-66-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Wannan hanya ce ta fara yin hasashe daga tebur sannan a tabbatar da shi da magana.

y-m-66-08.title: Za a iya amincewa da ƙimar integral definite 4.67?
y-m-66-08.topic: Hanyoyin integral: sauyawa da tazarar definite integral
y-m-66-08.goal: Nemo kuskuren da ya faru saboda rashin kula da tazara a definite integral da aka warware ta sauyawa, yi amfani da girman ƙima don duba sakamakon ba tare da lissafi ba, sannan ka sake rubuta mafita daidai.
y-m-66-08.material: Jiho ya warware definite integral ∫2x·e^(x²) dx (daga x=1 zuwa x=2; karanta: integral na 2x sau e zuwa ƙarfin x squared, dx) kamar haka. Wannan aikin g(x)=2x·e^(x²) yana ƙaruwa koyaushe a tazara 1≤x≤2, g(1)≈5.44 kuma g(2)≈218.4.
y-m-66-08.prereq.1: Ma’anar definite integral: ƙimar da ta dace da yankin (yanki mai alama) a kan tazara rufaffiya
y-m-66-08.prereq.2: Babban ra’ayin sauyawa a integral (matakin gabatarwa)
y-m-66-08.prereq.3: Gaskiyar cewa indefinite integral na e^x shi ne e^x
y-m-66-08.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda a mafitar Jiho inda hukuncin ya fara kuskure.
y-m-66-08.s.s1.hint.0: Saka x=1 da x=2 cikin u=x², ka rubuta ƙimomin u, sannan ka kwatanta da tazarar layi na 2.
y-m-66-08.s.s1.hint.1: Canjin alama a ∫e^u du na layi na 3 shi ne u, saboda haka duba wane ƙima ce tazarar integral ta bayar.
y-m-66-08.s.s1.line.0: Idan aka sa u=x², du=2x dx.
y-m-66-08.s.s1.line.1: Tazarar x daga 1 zuwa 2 ce, don haka a bar ta haka a canza zuwa ∫e^u du (daga 1 zuwa 2).
y-m-66-08.s.s1.explain: Kuskuren yana layi na 2. Tazarar 1 zuwa 2 ƙimomin x ce, amma canjin alama ya koma u, saboda haka tazarar ma dole ta koma ƙimomin u (u=1 idan x=1, u=4 idan x=2). Layuka 3 da 4 sakamakon tazarar da ba daidai ba ne. Layi na 1 daidai ne.
y-m-66-08.s.s2.prompt: Kafin sake rubuta mafitar, wane bincike ne zai nuna cewa 4.67 abin mamaki ne ta girman ƙima kaɗai?
y-m-66-08.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta ƙaramin ƙimar g(x) a tazarar, ka nemo ƙaramin yanki da integral zai iya zama idan g aƙalla wannan ƙima ce a tazara mai tsawo 1.
y-m-66-08.s.s2.hint.1: Bambanta ko g(2)≈218 za a iya amfani da ita a matsayin iyakar sama ko ƙasa ta ƙimar integral.
y-m-66-08.s.s2.o.a: g(2)≈218.4 kuma tsawon tazara 1 ne, saboda haka ƙimar integral dole aƙalla 218 ce, kuma 4.67 ƙarama ce sosai.
y-m-66-08.s.s2.r.a: Wannan ya yi amfani da ƙimar aikin a ƙarshen a matsayin ƙaramar iyakar integral ba daidai ba. Ƙimar ƙarshen ita ce mafi girma a duk tazarar kawai.
y-m-66-08.s.s2.o.b: Tazarar 1 zuwa 2 ce, saboda haka ƙimar integral dole ta kasance tsakanin 1 da 2, kuma 4.67 ta fi wannan kewayo girma.
y-m-66-08.s.s2.r.b: Wannan ya ɗauki ƙarshen tazara (ƙimomin x) da ƙimar integral (yanki) a ma’auni ɗaya.
y-m-66-08.s.s2.o.c: g aƙalla 5.44 ce a tazarar, tsawonta kuma 1 ne, don haka ƙimar integral aƙalla 5.44 ce, kuma 4.67 ta fi ƙanƙanta.
y-m-66-08.s.s2.r.c: Wannan binciken ya samo ƙaramar iyakar yanki daga ƙaramin ƙimar aikin da tsawon tazara.
y-m-66-08.s.s2.explain: g yana ƙaruwa a tazarar, don haka ƙaramin ƙimarsa g(1)≈5.44 ce. Idan g≥5.44 a duk tazarar tsawon 1, dole yankin ya kai aƙalla 5.44; 4.67 kuma ya gaza. Ƙimar ƙarshen 218 tana ba da iyakar sama kawai (ƙimar integral ≤218.4).

y-m-66-05.s.s2.r.d: Wannan ya fahimci cewa rashin daidaito a wuri guda yana karya da’awar “kowane x”.
y-m-66-05.s.s2.explain: Ƙimar da aka lissafa kusan 2 ce, dabarar Seoa kuma tana bayar da 1, saboda haka kuskure ba zai bayyana bambancin ba. Rashin daidaito a x=0 kaɗai ya karya da’awar cewa dabarar tana aiki ga kowane x.
y-m-66-05.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta f′(x) daidai, ka bayyana abin da ya ɓace daga dabarar Seoa ta haɗa shi da ƙimar a x=0.
y-m-66-05.s.s3.hint.0: Duba ko ƙimar da dabarar daidai ta bayar a x=0 tana kusa da 1.99999.
y-m-66-05.s.s3.hint.1: A cikin sin 2x, yi tunanin nawa ne 2x na ciki yake canzawa idan x ya canza da 1, ka duba ko wannan ya shiga dabarar.
y-m-66-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ƙimar f′(0) da ka rubuta ta yi daidai da sakamakon lissafi 1.99999?
y-m-66-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka ce abin da ya ɓace ba lambar “2” kawai ba ce, har da saurin canjin aikin ciki?
y-m-66-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka bambanta cewa Seoa ba ta yi kuskuren amfani da (sin x)′=cos x ba?
y-m-66-05.s.s3.model.0: f′(x)=2cos 2x. Ya kamata a ninka da 2 daga nemo abin da aka samu na aikin ciki 2x, amma wannan ne ya ɓace a dabarar Seoa. A x=0, 2cos 0=2, wanda ya yi daidai da ƙimar lissafi 1.99999.
y-m-66-05.s.s3.model.1: (sin 2x)′=cos(2x)×(2x)′=2cos 2x. Seoa ta canza sin zuwa cos kawai, ba ta ninka da canjin aikin ciki 2x ba. Saboda haka a x=0 dabararta ta ba da 1, daidai kuma tana ba da 2; bambancin ninkawa sau biyu ne.

y-m-66-09.title: Haɗa integral na ninkawa, kwatanta hanyoyi biyu
y-m-66-09.topic: Hanyoyin integral: zaɓar rawar abubuwa wajen haɗa ninkawa
y-m-66-09.goal: Kwatanta cewa idan ana haɗa ninkawa, zaɓuɓɓukan “wane ɓangare za a nemo abin da aka samu, wanne kuma za a haɗa” duk suna ba da daidaito, amma ɗaya na iya fi ko gaza dacewa bisa manufa; bayyana ƙa’idar zaɓe da misalai biyu.
y-m-66-09.material: Mutane biyu suna neman ∫x·e^x dx. (Karanta: integral na x sau e zuwa ƙarfin x, dx. e^x aikin exponential ne. Yi amfani da dabarar abubuwan da aka koya a sama.) Hayun: ya sa f=x da g′=e^x, ya samu x·e^x−∫e^x dx=x·e^x−e^x+C. Dohyun: ya sa f=e^x da g′=x, ya rubuta har zuwa (x²/2)·e^x−∫(x²/2)·e^x dx sannan ya tsaya. Ɓangarorin dama na daidaiton biyun sun fito daga dabarar.
y-m-66-09.thinking.0: Kwatanta da kimanta tsarin mafita biyu
y-m-66-09.thinking.1: Duba gama-garawa fiye da kima (“koyaushe nemo abin da aka samu na x”)
y-m-66-09.thinking.2: Bayyana ƙa’idar zaɓe tare da dalilai
y-m-66-09.prereq.1: Ƙa'idar samfurin asalawa da dabarar da ta biyo daga gare ta, ∫ f·g′ dx = f·g − ∫ f′·g dx
y-m-66-09.prereq.2: Integral marar iyaka na e^x ita ce e^x, kuma asalawar ln x ita ce 1/x.
y-m-66-09.prereq.3: A wannan mataki za ka iya yarda da gaskiyar cewa integral marar iyaka na ln x ita ce x ln x − x.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk maganganun da suka dace game da hanyoyin mutanen biyun.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.hint.0: A lissafin farko na Dohyun, rubuta abin da f da g′ suke, da kuma f′ da g suke, sannan ka daidaita su da siffar gefen dama na ƙa'idar.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta ta fuska integral ɗin da Hayun da Dohyun kowannensu ya bari a ƙarshe, ∫ e^x dx da ∫ (x²/2)·e^x dx, da matsalar asali ∫ x·e^x dx.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.o.a: Lissafin farko na Dohyun ma lissafi ne daidai da aka rubuta bisa ƙa'idar.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.r.a: Wannan ya daidaita f, g′, f′, da g sannan ya kwatanta da ƙa'idar.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.o.b: Dohyun ya musanya matsayin f da g′, saboda haka ya yi amfani da ƙa'idar ba daidai ba.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.r.b: Wannan bai bincika ko ƙa'idar tana aiki ko da an musanya matsayen f da g′ ba.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.o.c: Hanyar Dohyun ba kuskure ba ce, amma integral ɗin da ya rage ya fi rikitarwa, don haka bai dace da wannan matsalar ba.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.r.c: Wannan ya bambanta lissafi daidai da tambayar ko ya fi dacewa ko bai dace ba da manufar.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.o.d: Amma ta hanyar Dohyun, ko yaya aka warware ta, sakamakon zai bambanta da na Hayun.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.r.d: Wannan ya rasa cewa integrals marasa iyaka suna daidai sai da bambancin wata ƙima tsayayye. Ya ɗauki hanya marar daidai da hanya marar amfani a matsayin iri ɗaya.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.explain: Lissafin farko na Dohyun daidai ne, yana amfani da ƙa'idar daidai da f=e^x, g′=x, f′=e^x, g=x²/2. Amma integral ɗin da ya rage ∫(x²/2)·e^x dx yana da ƙarfin x mafi girma fiye da matsalar asali, kuma ya fi wahala; saboda haka bai dace da wannan matsalar ba.
y-m-66-09.s.s2.prompt: A wannan karon matsalar ita ce ∫ x·ln x dx. Wane bayani ne ya fi dacewa wajen tantance zaɓin 'kamar Hayun, a sa x ya zama f (ɓangaren da za a asalawa)'?
y-m-66-09.s.s2.hint.0: Ga zaɓuɓɓukan biyu (f=x ko f=ln x), nemo ka rubuta f′ da g ga kowanne, sannan ka kwatanta zaɓin da ke sauƙaƙa gano g.
y-m-66-09.s.s2.hint.1: Ga kowace zaɓi, rubuta siffar integral ɗin da ya rage ∫ f′·g dx, sannan ka kwatanta ko ya fi sauƙi fiye da integral na asali.
y-m-66-09.s.s2.o.a: Da farko dole ne a gano g=∫ln x dx, saboda haka f=ln x ya fi sauƙi.
y-m-66-09.s.s2.r.a: Sun zaɓa ta hanyar kwatanta siffar integral ɗin da ya rage da lissafin tsaka-tsaki da ake buƙata.
y-m-66-09.s.s2.o.b: x magana mafi sauƙi ce, saboda haka koyaushe ya fi kyau a sa x ya zama f a kowane samfur.
y-m-66-09.s.s2.r.b: Ya faɗaɗa misali guda da ya yi aiki, samfurin e^x, zuwa duk samfura.
y-m-66-09.s.s2.o.c: Ba za a iya samun integral na ln x ba, saboda haka ba zai yiwu a zaɓe shi a matsayin g′ ba sam.
y-m-66-09.s.s2.r.c: Wannan ya ɗauka ba zai yiwu ba domin bai san cewa integral marar iyaka na ln x yana samuwa ba (x ln x−x).
y-m-66-09.s.s2.explain: Idan aka sa f=x, g′=ln x, da farko dole a gano g=x ln x−x. Idan aka sa f=ln x, g′=x, to f′=1/x, g=x²/2, kuma integral ɗin da ya rage ∫(x/2) dx ne, mai sauƙi ƙwarai. Saboda haka a wannan matsala ya fi kyau a sa ln x a gefen da za a asalawa.
y-m-66-09.s.s3.prompt: Kwatanta zaɓin ɓangaren da za a asalawa (f) a ∫x·e^x dx da ∫x·ln x dx, sannan ka rubuta ƙa'idar zaɓen f, kana kawo sakamakon matsalolin biyu.
y-m-66-09.s.s3.hint.0: Ga kowace matsala biyu, rubuta jimla ɗaya kan yadda magana take sauyawa idan aka asalawa f.
y-m-66-09.s.s3.hint.1: Ga matsalolin biyun, kwatanta ka rubuta ko integral ɗin da ya rage bayan warwarewa da f ɗin da ka zaɓa ya fi sauƙi ko wahala fiye da na asali.

y-m-66-09.s.s3.model.0: A x·e^x, idan aka sa f=x, yana zama 1 bayan asalawa, integral ɗin da ya rage kuma e^x kaɗai ne, mai sauƙi. A x·ln x, asalawar ln x tana ba da 1/x, wanda yake sauƙi idan ya haɗu da x, saboda haka ka sa f=ln x. Ƙa'idar ita ce zaɓen ɓangaren da ke sauƙaƙa bayan an asalawa f, sannan integral ɗin da ya rage ya fi sauƙi.
y-m-66-09.s.s3.model.1: Maimakon ƙa'idar 'x koyaushe f ne', kwatanta ko integral ɗin da ya rage ∫f′·g dx ya fi sauƙi fiye da na asali. A matsalar e^x, sa x a matsayin f yana rage ƙarfin sa ya sauƙaƙa; a ta ln x, sa ln x a matsayin f yana sa samfurin g=x²/2 da f′=1/x ya zama x/2, mai sauƙi. Idan aka musanya matsayensu, duka biyun sun fi rikitarwa.
y-m-66-09.s.s3.model.2: A matsalar aikin exponential, sa x a matsayin f; a matsalar logarithm, sa ln x a matsayin f. Zaɓi a matsayin f ɓangaren da asalawarsa take da sauƙi, sannan ka duba ko integral ɗin da ya rage ya fi sauƙi.
